about: The meetups page (/en/meetups/, /ar/meetups/; ticket #43, PRD D11). The meetups are organised on founders.coffee, and the page links there: url is its address, and each link is a path under it, with {lang} for the page's language (en or ar). checked is the day a person last opened every link; site/tools/links.py opens them every week. docs/meetups.md explains the move.
title: Founders Coffee
